method.kind: Deterministic theoretical push-forward of independent bounded triangular angular errors
method.density: p_goal = ((1-|u|)(1-|v|)) / abs(det(d(goalX,goalY)/d(u,v))). u and v are angular errors normalized to their hard bounds.
method.contourMeaning: 50/90/99% exact angular probability sets, mapped to goal-plane space. Heat uses projected density per square metre; contours are not spatial iso-density contours.
method.boundMeaning: Full rectangular support in angular-error coordinates mapped through frozen flight physics. Display uses a validated bilinear mesh; boundary is not a confidence ellipse.
